body: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.
summaryZh: 对话和协作助手需要频繁判断合作伙伴的知识、信念或意图。本文介绍了Jev-ToM基准，在来自九个心智理论基准的11,117个英语文本问题上，对比了五个类型化决策模型与七个生成式基线。TypeSafe Jev在所有六个能力组中均名列前茅或第二，源平衡准确率达到73.2%。资源对比表明该方法能降低重复选择的成本与等待时间。研究指出任务特定的置信度校准和输出验证是集成时的优先级，为未来心智理论在助手组件中的应用奠定了基础。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该文提出了Jev-ToM基准以评估类型化决策模型与大模型在心智理论上的表现，对比分析为智能体协作和有界心智推理提供了宝贵的数据支撑。

glossary.explanationZh: 心智理论，指推断他人信念、意图、知识和情感等心理状态的能力。
类型化决策模型，一种区别于通用生成式大模型的结构化推理选择模型。
生成式基线，用于对比评估的传统自回归大语言模型。
置信度校准，指评估模型对其判断准确度预测的可信赖程度。
